description: A woman on a diet needs to eat two types of meal preps, a smoothie and a protein bar. Each smoothie contains 2 units of protein and 300 calories. Each protein bar contains 7 units of protein and 250 calories. The woman must eat 2 times more protein bars than smoothies. If the woman can consume at most 2000 calories, how many of each should she eat or drink to maximize her protein intake?

ProteinPerBar.definition: Amount of protein per protein bar

CaloriesPerBar.definition: Amount of calories per protein bar

BarToSmoothieRatio.definition: Ratio of protein bars to smoothies

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total protein intake from consuming smoothies and protein bars"

constraints.description: Number of protein bars consumed must be equal to BarToSmoothieRatio times the number of smoothies consumed
CaloriesPerSmoothie * (number of smoothies) + CaloriesPerBar * (number of protein bars) must be less than or equal to MaxCalories
Number of smoothies consumed must be greater than or equal to 0
